summary: The exact candidate is test-only hardening over a base that already contains the relevant EAGLE result-transfer redesign. Its tests pass on gfx950 and validate source shape, pinned CPU outputs, exact values, and an empty boundary, but they do not prove that D2H remains nonblocking: the runtime test would also pass with non_blocking=False. The AST guard is also bypassed by moving a synchronous conversion into a helper. The original TP8 H200/GLM-5.1 near-full-KV hang remains unverified.

tests.what_was_measured: Candidate suite passed 3 tests on gfx950: direct-call AST guard, pinned D2H output values for a nonempty result, and empty-result handling.

tests.command: Run the exact candidate test file on recorded base 358c163250ad3b1f62939b01ce1314a0a31a0365
tests.what_was_measured: The candidate suite also passed unchanged on the required base (3 passed), proving it is not failing-before/passing-after relative to that base.
A run_eagle_verify function calling a helper that performs Tensor.tolist() produced an empty forbidden-call list and would pass the candidate guard.

tests.command: Inspect candidate runtime assertions against a blocking pinned-copy substitution
tests.what_was_measured: CPU placement, pinning, and exact values after event synchronization do not distinguish non_blocking=True from non_blocking=False.

gpu_execution.evidence: The exact candidate suite executed on HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 using AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950 with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, including real device tensors, pinned host allocation, D2H copying, event synchronization, and exact comparisons.

remaining_counterexamples: Changing _async_d2h to use copy_(..., non_blocking=False) would retain all candidate runtime-test outcomes, so the claimed nonblocking property is not regression-tested.
A synchronous Tensor.tolist()/cpu()/numpy() conversion placed in a helper called by run_eagle_verify bypasses the lexical AST guard.
The original production hang could still depend on TP8 coordination, CUDA/H200 behavior, GLM-5.1 FP8 execution, or near-full KV/memory pressure, none of which the candidate fixture exercises.
remaining_limitations: Only one AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 GPU was available, not eight H200 GPUs.
TP8, CUDA/H200 semantics, 80K-160K prompts, near-full KV pressure, and watchdog behavior were not reproduced.
No native files changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
